name: EroDQs ~Gothic Lolita Souryo Junan Hen~
source:
*Between battles girls are assaulted by a monstrous main character. Is he going to have his way with them in spite of the overlord!?

Gothic lolita priestesses and familiar looking female warriors and church sisters all get violated, gang banged, and brought to the limits of depravity with a monster orgy. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037686.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
*在战斗之间，女孩们遭到了怪物主角的攻击。难道他还要不顾霸主的威逼而对他们为所欲为吗！？

哥特式洛丽塔女祭司、看起来很熟悉的女战士和教堂修女都遭到侵犯、轮奸，并通过怪物狂欢达到了堕落的极限。
